newsitem.title: USA: Parker & Parsley sets MIPS exchange.
newsitem.headline: Parker & Parsley sets MIPS exchange.

text.p: Parker & Parsley Petroleum Co said Monday it has elected to exercise its right to require holders of 6-1/4 percent cumulative guaranteed monthly income convertible preferred shares of Parker & Parsley Capital LLC -- the "MIPS" -- to mandatorily exchange all MIPS for Parker & Parsley Petroleum Co common.
The mandatory exchange will be effective immediately before the close of business on July 28, 1997.

As a result of the mandatory exchange, each share of MIPS will be converted into 1.7778 shares of Parker & Parsley common stock, or a total of about 6.7 million shares. Cash will be paid in lieu of fractional shares based on the closing price on Friday, July 25, of $38.25 per share.
With the conversion of the MIPS, Parker & Parsley said, it will have 41.8 million shares outstanding.

The company said it believes the effects of the mandatory exchange include strengthening Parker & Parsley's balance sheet and eliminating annual dividend payments on the MIPS of $11.8 million each year.
